resources.string: Enter the height of your phone above the ground (in meters), then hold it level and tap Calibrate
Calibrated. Aim at the base of the object and tap \"Set Base\"
Aim the crosshair at the base of the object, then tap Set Base
Now aim the crosshair at the top of the object, then tap Set Top
Aim the crosshair at a point on the ground, then tap Measure
